title: periscope-agent Helm values
description: Values for the periscope-agent chart (#42). Validates required fields at install time so operators get a clear error instead of a template-side fail.

serverURL.description: Central Periscope tunnel URL. Both shapes accepted — base URL (e.g. wss://agents.periscope.example.com:8443) or full URL with the /api/agents/connect path; the agent normalises both to the canonical wss://host[:port]/api/agents/connect. Scheme: wss:// in production, ws:// for local/dev, http(s):// also accepted (auto-translated to ws(s):// for the WebSocket upgrade).

clusterName.description: Cluster name as registered with the central server. Must match a clusters[].name entry of backend: agent. Validated against the same DNS-1123-ish rule the server enforces.

registrationToken.description: Bootstrap token from POST /api/agents/tokens. Required on first install only — leave empty on subsequent upgrades. Single-use, 15-min TTL.

registrationURL.description: Optional URL for the unauth registration POST. Set when central server splits HTTP and mTLS onto different LBs (#48). Both shapes accepted — base URL (e.g. http://192.168.0.6:31429) or full URL with the /api/agents/register path; the agent normalises both to the canonical http(s)://host[:port]/api/agents/register. Empty = derive from serverURL.

serverCAHash.description: Optional SPKI hash for kubeadm-style pinning on the registration TLS dial. Format: sha256:<64 hex chars>. When set, the agent skips standard chain validation and pins on this hash instead — bootstraps against self-signed central servers without distributing the full CA.

stateSecretName.description: Name of the K8s Secret the agent persists its mTLS cert + key + server CA into.

healthAddr.description: Bind addr for the kubelet probe target. Format ':PORT'.

logLevel.description: Optional agent log level. Empty = use the binary default (info). Set debug to enable per-request access logs through the proxy.

execIdleSeconds.description: Per-connection idle timeout (seconds) for hijacked exec WS/SPDY streams. Mirrors the server's PERISCOPE_EXEC_IDLE_SECONDS (default 600). Set 0 to disable.

replicaCount.description: Tunnel sessions are 1:1 with agent pods; HA needs server-side peer routing (v1.5+). Single replica only for v1.x.

enabled.description: When true, the chart binds a ClusterRole granting the agent SA cluster-wide read + impersonate. Set false to ship a tighter custom ClusterRole and bind it yourself.

env.description: Extra env vars appended to the container's env list. Use for future PERISCOPE_* knobs that don't yet have a dedicated values field.

clusterRBAC.description: Auto-create the ClusterRoleBindings that map periscope-tier:* groups to K8s built-in roles (read→view, write→edit) plus the custom triage + maintain ClusterRoles. The admin tier → cluster-admin binding is now opt-in via adminTier.enabled (#84). Without these bindings, requests reaching this managed cluster get 403 Forbidden — see Issue 2.5 in deployment-journey.md. Default enabled=true so deployment-out-of-the-box works; disable if you want to ship a tighter custom set.

enabled.description: When true, the chart installs ClusterRoleBindings for the read / triage / write / maintain tier groups + the triage/maintain custom ClusterRoles. The admin tier binding is gated separately by adminTier.enabled.

adminTier.description: Issue #84: cluster-admin tier binding is opt-in. Default install does not render the periscope-tier:admin ClusterRoleBinding so CIS 5.1.1 / AWS Guardrails pass out of the box.

enabled.description: Render the periscope-tier:admin ClusterRoleBinding on this managed cluster. Default false.

clusterRoleName.description: Target ClusterRole for the admin tier. Defaults to `cluster-admin`. Operators who want a tighter posture can point at a custom role they ship out-of-band.

clusterShell.description: Cluster-shell (#104) RBAC scaffolding on this managed cluster. When the central server has clusterShell enabled, the agent chart pre-creates the periscope-system namespace, the per-tier ServiceAccounts + impersonator ClusterRoles, and binds the agent SA to the periscope-shell-provisioner Role so server-side pod create/delete calls succeed through the tunnel. Opt-in (default false); tiers MUST match the server's clusterShell.tiers.

namespace.description: Where ephemeral shell pods + per-session Secrets land. Must match the server's clusterShell.namespace.

tiers.description: Allow-list of tiers that may open a cluster-shell session. Must match the server's clusterShell.tiers exactly — a tier present on the server but missing here would 403 when a session tries to mint its SA token.
